description: Ohio State — strong OH in-state applicant, RD (residency-neutral state → NO boost)
rationale: Burden-of-proof sentinel. The 2026-05-31 audit found OSU's own CDS shows in-state 57.3% ≈ out-of-state 59.0% — residency is NOT priced. OH carries no entry in STATE_IN_STATE_OVER_OVERALL, so the new DEFAULT 1.0 (neutral) applies: anchor 0.508 × geo 1.0 × this strong profile's stat boost (~1.4×) ≈ 0.71. Guardrail [0.62, 0.8] guards against regressing to the old flat 1.2 default, which would lift this to ~0.85 (caught above 0.8) — the over-prediction that hit all 34 residency-neutral states.
